subject: M1 Blockstate + JSON model pipeline (all 1,198 states)
description: Foundation milestone, unblocks items/crafting/structures/survival. Measured vanilla surface: 1,198 blockstates (1,096 variant-keyed, only 102 multipart), 7,296 variant entries, 61 distinct properties, 2,657 block models (1,183 raw elements / 4,227 faces), 1,269 block PNGs + 179 mcmeta. Today scripts/build-assets.mjs:277 throws on multipart and bakes exactly ONE variant per block (85 blocks). Work: (1) real JSON model loader with parent/element inheritance, from/to, faces (uv, texture, cullface, tintindex, uvlock), element x/y rotation, render_type, ambientocclusion; (2) variant-key dispatcher covering all 1,096 variant blockstates with a property table and state-id encoding; (3) multipart condition trees for the 102 files (AND/OR, selectors, weight); (4) runtime state ids in the chunk array, placement inferring facing/axis/half/type from look+sneak, connecting behaviour for stairs/fences/panes/walls; (5) expand the texture array to the full block set. Verification: stairs of all 4 facings + top/bottom + corners, slabs both types, fence/pane connections, log all 3 axes, bed two-part, and a screenshot comparison per family.
